newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan oil firms plan oil output in PNG - paper.
newsitem.headline: Japan oil firms plan oil output in PNG - paper.

text.p: Japanese oil companies Japan Energy Corp and Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd plan to start commercial production of crude oil from 1998 in Papua New Guinea, the Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
Japan Energy officials were not immediately available for comment.
"We have not yet been informed if our application has been approved," a Mitsubishi Oil official told Reuters.
The companies are involved in separate projects.
The paper said on Monday that Chevron Corp of the United States and other Japanese oil producers would participate in the projects.
A Mitsubishi Oil spokesman said the company's project and Japan Energy's project were different, adding they were planning their respective projects in neighbouring oil fields.
